base_member_text: patch placement can exceed array bounds only if xstart+widthx+max(sizes) > m; here 250+350+80=680 > m=656, so an out-of-bounds write at L46 is possible for unlucky rand draws; with rng(2) the actual draws evidently fit, but the script is not generally safe
audit_member_text: Random origins are not bounded by feature size and MATLAB's 1-based matrix indices. With ystart=0 and widthy=150 (L14-L16,L25), `yy1` can be zero, while the insertion at L46 uses it directly as an index. Also y0 can approach 149 and sizes reach 80, exceeding n=200; x0 can approach 599 and size 80 exceeds m=656. The seeded draws may or may not hit each invalid case, but the declared sampling range permits deterministic out-of-bounds failures.

base_member_text: k=30 (L4) is never used; second ylabel at L77 overwrites the first and labels the y-axis 'points in x' on a y axis; figure 1 (patch rectangles) is never printed (L59 commented)
audit_member_text: The second pcolor panel calls ylabel twice at L76-L77, with the latter text `points in x`; this is a copy/paste error that overwrites the y label instead of setting xlabel.
`k=30` at L4 is never read. Plot writes assume the `plots` directory already exists.

base_member_text: with dep_flat=2 and rat=1.005 the deepest hill crest reaches dep=2-2/1.005=0.00995 before the slope is added, keeping cells barely wet; after adding slope values 10.0 down to 10.0-0.03*655=-9.65 (L85) the right part of the domain becomes negative depth (dry hills), consistent with the rain_on_hills case name, but intended still-water datum is not documented

audit_member_text: Min-max normalization at L53-L55 has no guard for `mm==mn`; empty/zero feature settings or an all-clipped relief would divide by zero and contaminate `dep` at L57.
